themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants in housing, social services, and employment. This theme has seen strong convergence as parties like Vox in Spain, Fratelli d'Italia in Italy, and Rassemblement National in France align their legislative agendas around 'national priority' rhetoric, often clashing with EU norms and domestic opposition.

themes.title: Manuel Adorni scandal paralyzes Argentina's government
themes.blurb: The resignation of Argentina's Chief of Staff Manuel Adorni amid corruption allegations has triggered a cross-national ripple effect, with right-wing media and political figures in the U.S., Italy, and Spain using the scandal to critique libertarian governance models. The crisis has exposed fractures within La Libertad Avanza and prompted a cabinet reshuffle aimed at restoring stability ahead of 2027 elections.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe
themes.blurb: A coordinated push against LGBTQ+ rights is unfolding across Europe, with far-right parties introducing legislation to restrict Pride events, ban gender-affirming policies in schools, and challenge same-sex parenting rights. This theme has gained traction amid broader culture wars, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, and Reform UK framing these measures as defenses of 'traditional values' and national identity.
